Applicant seeks regular bail in FIR No. 365/2025 dated 23.05.2025, for commission of offences under Section 137(2) of Bhartiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 (corresponding Section 363 of IPC),
registered at P.S. Aman Vihar.

Subsequently, in the chargesheet, offences under Section 64(2)/87 of Bhartiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 (corresponding Section 376/366 of IPC) and Section 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, were added.

4.
The Jail Superintendent concerned is directed to send the Nominal Roll of the applicant before the next date of hearing.
Learned Trial Court is also requested to expedite the ascertainment of charges.
